name: Flight Tracker
tagline: Finds real flight and hotel deals and watches booked trips for you
description: A travel deal scout that searches flights, hotels and rental cars side by side, then keeps watch on trips you have already locked in. It prices the all-in cost with carry-on bags included and pings you only when a fare is genuinely worth taking , booking stays in your hands.
author: realgary12
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
